Name: JPEG 2000 Layers
Description: The J2KLRA TRE provides support information for JPEG 2000 compressed files. It gives users information about number of resolution levels, number of quality layers, and number of bands in both the original data and derived products.

ORIG.Name: Original Compressed Data
ORIG.Description: This field indicates if the image is in the same original JPEG 2000 compression or it has been parsed to a new JPEG 2000 compression. The conditional fields (NLEVELS_I, NLAYERS_I, NBANDS_I) are present if this field indicates a parsed stream.

NLEVELS_O.Name: Number Wavelet Levels
NLEVELS_O.Description: This field contains the number of wavelet decomposition levels performed in the original image.

NBANDS_O.Name: Number Bands
NBANDS_O.Description: This field contains the number of bands in the original image.

NLAYERS_O.Name: Number Layers
NLAYERS_O.Description: This field contains the number of layers in the original image.

LAYER_ID.Name: Layer ID Number
LAYER_ID.Description: This field contains the number of the layer, numbered from 0 to NLAYERS_O - 1. 0 is layer with the lowest bitrate.

BITRATE.Name: Bit Rate
BITRATE.Description: This field contains the accumulated bitrate target associated with this and associated lower layers, defined in bits per pixel per band. Bitrate may be unachieved due to data characteristics. For numerically lossless quality, the bitrate for the final layer is an expected value based on past performance. If no target bitrate, report the achieved bitrate.

NLEVELS_I.Name: Number Wavelet Levels
NLEVELS_I.Description: This field contains the number of wavelet decompositions levels included in this image as defined in the COD marker segment.

NBANDS_I.Name: Number Bands
NBANDS_I.Description: This field contains the number of bands in this image as defined in the SIZ marker segment.

NLAYERS_I.Name: Number Layers
NLAYERS_I.Description: This field contains the number of layers in this image as defined in the COD marker segment.
